[=Verified Limits=]

[| [*Area*] | [*Verified boundary*] | [*Practical impact*] | [*First places to inspect*] |]
[| Generic type application across modules | [.txt|mModule_Tests -> Maybe.] fails at [.txt|.tMaybe tIn.] while [.txt|mModule.Init(...).] compiles [.txt|Modules/Maybe.SPO.] through [.txt|mSPO_AST_Types.AsVM_Type(GenericApplyType).] | generic regressions passing does not yet mean generic library modules are stable | [.txt|mModule.Tests.], [.txt|mModule.], [.txt|mSPO_AST_Types.], [.txt|Maybe.SPO.] |]
[| Runtime type values | [.txt|mVM_Data.tOpCode.], [.txt|mIL_GenerateOpcodes.], and [.txt|mVM.Step(...).] do not agree on the full [.txt|Type*.] family | type expressions as runtime values are only partially reliable | [.txt|mVM_Data.], [.txt|mIL_GenerateOpcodes.], [.txt|mVM.] |]
[| Runtime match opcodes | [.txt|TryAsType.] and [.txt|TryAsRef.] exist in IL-facing layers, but the VM has no execution case for them and no [.txt|Ref.] runtime value kind | IL/runtime matching support is broader on paper than it is in the executing VM | [.txt|mIL_AST.], [.txt|mIL_GenerateOpcodes.], [.txt|mVM_Data.], [.txt|mVM.] |]
[| Regression test discovery | [.txt|mRegression_Tests.] resolves [.txt|Regression.Tests.] through [.txt|mFS.CWD().] and prints [.txt|Folder not found: mFS+tFolder.] on a miss | running [.txt|mRunTests.] from the repo root silently drops the file-driven regression suite | [.txt|mRegression.Tests.], [.txt|mRunTests.], [.txt|mFS.] |]
[| Subtyping | [.txt|mVM_Type.IsSubType(...).] still throws [.txt|NotImplementedException.] for [.txt|Any.], [.txt|Var.], [.txt|Ref.], and [.txt|Cond.] | parts of the type system are parseable more broadly than they are actually decidable | [.txt|mVM_Type.] |]
[| Recursive proc materialization | [.txt|mVM.Step(...).] currently uses [.txt|Count = 1.] for [.txt|DefRecProcs.] | mutual recursion between multiple values remains a risk area | [.txt|mVM.] |]
[| Prefix and record-field identity | prefixes and record fields are mapped to [.txt|tNat32.] via [.txt|PrefixHash().] | theoretical hash collisions are not yet ruled out | [.txt|mIL_GenerateOpcodes.], [.txt|mVM_Data.] |]
[| Type desugaring | [.txt|mSPO_Desugar.DesugarType(...).] actively normalizes only tuple types | some type forms survive in their surface shape deep into the backend | [.txt|mSPO_Desugar.] |]

[=What The Tests Already Cover Cleanly=]

- parser and printer for IL commands and IL type commands
- SPO end-to-end for literals, records, matching, recursion, and [.txt|Â§VAR.]
- recursive and generic type syntax in regressions
- library modules [.txt|Std.], [.txt|Char.], and [.txt|Text.]
- the current working tree's [.txt|01_02_AssignFalse.] and [.txt|07_12_GenericTypes.] sanity checks

[=High-Value Clarifications=]

- [.txt|07_12_GenericTypes.] still passing is not the same claim as "generic modules are stable"
- a repo-root test run is not the same verification surface as a run launched from [.txt|SPO_CS/.]
- a syntax form being parseable or typed is not enough; this codebase only secures a feature once lowering, opcode generation, VM execution, and tests all agree

[=Concrete Extension Path=]

[.mermaid
|flowchart TD
|	FEATURE["New language or runtime feature"] --> PARSE["Tokenizer / Parser"]
|	FEATURE --> TYPE["mVM_Type + mSPO_AST_Types"]
|	FEATURE --> DES["mSPO_Desugar"]
|	FEATURE --> IL["mSPO2IL + mIL_AST"]
|	FEATURE --> OPC["mIL_GenerateOpcodes"]
|	FEATURE --> VM["mVM / mVM_Data"]
|	FEATURE --> TEST["Tests + Regressions + Modules"]
.]

Carry a feature through all of these layers before calling it finished:

o 1. Syntax
o 2. Type analysis
o 3. Lowering
o 4. Opcode generation
o 5. VM execution
o 6. Regression or module tests

For type-related work, verify [.txt|mVM_Data.tOpCode.], [.txt|mIL_GenerateOpcodes.], and [.txt|mVM.Step(...).] together.

[=Good Extension Points In Code=]

- [.txt|mSPO_Parser.]
  when new surface syntax is added
- [.txt|mSPO_Desugar.]
  when sugar should reduce to existing core forms
- [.txt|mSPO_AST_Types.]
  when new scope or type rules are needed
- [.txt|mSPO2IL.]
  when a feature exists in the AST but does not yet reach IL
- [.txt|mIL_GenerateOpcodes.]
  when IL already exists but still has no VM operation
- [.txt|mVM.]
  when runtime behavior or type opcodes are missing
- [.txt|mRegression_Tests.] and [.txt|mModule_Tests.]
  when a feature should be secured with real artifacts
